posts.t: Jake Evans saw the Bat-signal when Nick Suzuki was injured and stepped up, three points as the Canadiens have a (dreaded) two-goal lead headed into the third. Have they learned from their mistake yet? 3-1 Montreal after 40 minutes #GoHabsGo

It got better for the Habs as the period went on. They finish their first 20 minutes of Suzukiless hockey tied 1-1. Big kill to start the second, though, as Newhook, a penalty killer, sits in the box; normally, that would have meant some Suzuki PK shifts, a stark reminder of his importance #GoHabsGo

If the Canadiens are to weather the storm that is the Suzuki injury, they'll need their best players to step up and that includes Juraj Slafkovsky, the latest in my article for @Thehockeynews: thehockeynews.com/nhl/montreal... #GoHabsGo #CH #Canadiens #Habs #THN

Enormous challenge, but also an opportunity for the Canadiens.
However they handle playing without Suzuki will likely be determinant in their fate this season👇🏻

Massive blow for the Habs this morning, captain Nick Suzuki will be out for two to four weeks. #GoHabsGo The Habs say upper-body injury, but Suzuki did block a shot with his hand in the last game so that's probably the issue.

threads.t: With Nick Suzuki injured, Moritz Seider and Dawson Mercer are now tied for the longest streak of consecutive games played to begin their NHL careers
